name: business-evaluation
description: Business Evaluation phase 1 (prds/business-evaluation-plan.md § 5, rulings BE7, BE9, BE14, BE17): one CBusinessEvaluation record per evaluation area per engagement, linked to the engagement, the client profile, the approving user and the review session; Multiple Assigned Users and Collaborators on; the business profile answers on CClientProfile. Additive only. No field Read-only: the application writes them all (ruling 40). Handoff: business-evaluation-crm-handoff.md.

fields.name: evaluationArea
fields.label: Evaluation area
fields.tooltipText: The one subject this record evaluates. A round sends one record per area.

fields.name: evaluationRound
fields.label: Round
fields.tooltipText: 1 for the first evaluation of this engagement. A later re-evaluation is a new round; earlier rounds are kept.

fields.name: surveyVersion
fields.label: Survey version
fields.tooltipText: The survey definition the client answered, such as finance.v1.

fields.name: answers
fields.label: Answers (data)
fields.tooltipText: The submitted answers as JSON, for the analysis. Reviewers read Answers instead.

fields.name: scores
fields.label: Scores (data)
fields.tooltipText: JSON: each rubric dimension with its score from 1 to 5 and the reason.

fields.name: draftReport
fields.label: Draft report
fields.tooltipText: Written by the analysis and kept unchanged. Never shown or sent to the client.

fields.name: reviewedReport
fields.label: Reviewed report
fields.tooltipText: Starts as a copy of the draft report; the mentor and co-mentors correct it.

fields.name: analysisError
fields.label: Analysis error
fields.tooltipText: The last analysis failure, kept for Retry.

fields.name: evaluationProfile
fields.label: Business profile (evaluation)
fields.tooltipText: The business profile survey's answers as JSON, answered once before the first evaluation area.
